title: A Proxy-Based Method for Measuring Racial Disparities in~Text-to-Image~Generators
abstract: arXiv:2611.07132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present an automated method for auditing text-to-image generators for representational bias against ground-truth demographic benchmarks. Our approach adapts the racial proxy variables used in U.S. antidiscrimination law to provide a fine-grained comparative analysis of variations in racial representation in generated images. We classify each generated image by race and then compare the model's distribution to publicly available demographic benchmark data to identify patterns of over- and under-representation. We also measure skin tone using CIELAB values and calculate cosine similarity amongst groups of images in order to capture biases that don't show up in demographic comparisons such as differences in image quality across races and skin tones. We report on experiments testing three models (Imagen 4 Fast, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo, and Flux Schnell) using three categories of proxies (geographic, occupational, and surname) a

translated_title: 一种基于代理变量的方法，用于衡量文生图生成器中的种族差异
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种自动化方法，用于审计文生图生成器相对于真实人口统计基准的表征偏见。我们的方法借鉴了美国反歧视法中使用的种族代理变量，对生成图像中种族表征的变化进行细粒度的比较分析。我们对每张生成的图像按种族进行分类，然后将模型的分布与公开可用的人口统计基准数据进行比较，以识别过度表征和不足表征的模式。我们还使用CIELAB值测量肤色，并计算图像组之间的余弦相似度，以捕捉在人口统计比较中无法显现的偏见，例如不同种族和肤色之间图像质量的差异。我们报告了使用三类代理变量（地理、职业和姓氏）对三个模型（Imagen 4 Fast、Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo 和 Flux Schnell）进行测试的实验。
tldr: 该论文借鉴美国反歧视法中的种族代理变量，提出一种自动化审计方法，通过将生成图像的种族分布与真实人口基准数据比较，并结合肤色和图像质量分析，来衡量文生图模型中的种族表征偏见。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated audit method adapted from racial proxy variables in U.S. antidiscrimination law, which measures racial representational bias in text-to-image generators by comparing generated image distributions against demographic benchmarks and analyzing skin tone and image quality disparities.
